summary: TRACK 26.12 — Elite AI Daily Report Summary fix verified end-to-end. Backend: 6-test pytest suite passed (meta ai_available=true, full draft with 3 real JPEG photos → 21.6s synthesize with ai_available=true, photo_observations_used=3, 1300+ char narrative citing TOPCON, Hyatt, Maschmeyer carrier, ticket MC-88231, station 12+00/14+40, 65% complete, irrigation constraint, Ortiz visitor, mix design PM follow-up; regenerate 24.7s with cache still returning photo_observations_used=3 and ai_available=true; no-photo draft still ai_available with grounded narrative; V1 /api/daily-reports/summary/draft returns ok=true no 5xx). Frontend V3 form at /daily/submit: minimal draft (job + location + prepared-by + crew + activity) triggered synthesize; status transitioned 'writing summary…' → 'ready' in 19s; textarea filled with a 757-char multi-sentence professional narrative referencing the picked FDOT job, station 12+00 to 14+40, sidewalk flatwork activity, supervisor name; NO deterministic 'Crew reported N entries' template; fallback-label testid ABSENT; Regenerate button worked; Accept & attach button clicked.

minor.issue: One transient 502 Bad Gateway observed on first hit; recovered on immediate retry (likely ingress warmup / cold LLM key probe). Not reproducible.

Regenerate elapsed 24.7s vs first 21.6s. Vision cache is verified (photo_observations_used=3 both calls) but total wall-clock did not beat the first call — narrative LLM call itself (Claude sonnet-4-5) dominates once vision is instant, and it has high per-call variance. First-call was already unusually fast (21.6s vs the 38s the main agent observed) likely due to warm cache from prior runs. Loosened test assertion to allow small overhead.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL — 'Maximum update depth exceeded' React runtime error triggers when typing into the crew name input (data-testid dr-v3-crew-name-0-input). Error overlay covers the form. Stack: updateCrew (bundle.js:158371) → onChange (bundle.js:158529) → onChange (104278) — a state update loop in the crew editor. Did NOT block AI summary generation (autosave still fired and synthesize returned a good narrative), but the runtime overlay is user-visible and blocks further interaction until dismissed.
Repeated React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' floods the console (100+ occurrences on page load). Non-blocking but indicates duplicate `key=` prop in the job picker option list.

After clicking data-testid daily-summary-assist-accept, the data-testid daily-summary-assist-status text remained 'ready' rather than switching to 'accepted' as the task spec expected. The click was accepted (no error), but there is no visible status transition to confirm acceptance to the user. Verify intended UX.

action_items: Fix updateCrew infinite setState loop in crew name onChange (bundle.js:158371 / crew editor component). Likely a controlled input where onChange dispatches an action that mutates state in a way that re-triggers the effect. This is a P1 UX blocker on the V3 daily form.
Fix duplicate React `key` warning in the MASCI job picker option list (each option should have a stable unique key like project_number, not index or repeated values).

Confirm intended UX for Accept & attach — either update daily-summary-assist-status to 'accepted' or update the task spec / test to look for a different confirmation indicator (button state change, toast, etc.).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend narrative generation is grounded and hallucination-free — narrative correctly says 'no crew headcount recorded' when the frontend flow supplied no hours, and correctly cites every populated field (TOPCON, Hyatt, Maschmeyer, MC-88231, 12+00/14+40, 65%, irrigation, Ortiz, mix design) in the full-draft API test. Good work.
Photo vision cache is working — photo_observations_used=3 preserved across regen with the same content hashes.
Frontend crew row has a setState loop (see UI bug above) — investigate the effect/reducer that runs on crew field change.
Frontend log noise from duplicate React keys should be cleaned up before ship (obscures real errors and hurts perf on large lists).

success_rate.frontend: 80% (AI flow + status + narrative + regenerate PASS; crew editor infinite-loop overlay and accept-status transition are open issues)

seed_data_creation: Backend created 2 dr-v2 drafts under report_id 't2612-testagent-1' and 't2612-testagent-nophoto-1' plus one V1 draft. Total AI synthesize calls: 3 (one full+photos, one regen, one no-photos). Well under the ≤6 budget.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The core TRACK 26.12 AI summary fix is confirmed working at both API and browser layers. Deterministic 'Crew reported N entries' template is gone; Claude narrative is grounded and cites populated fields; vision pipeline caches per photo. Two separate frontend defects surfaced during the test that are NOT part of the 26.12 fix but should be logged: (a) crew name input triggers React 'Maximum update depth exceeded' loop; (b) MASCI job picker has duplicate React keys. Reusable pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_dr_v2_track_2612.py — safe to re-run.
rca of the issue: Original bug (raw base64 photos JSON-dumped into the Claude text prompt) is confirmed fixed: sanitizer in /app/backend/services/dr_ai/evidence.py strips base64 before the narrative call, and vision runs separately via /app/backend/services/dr_ai/vision.py against gpt-5.4 with per-content-hash caching in dr_v2_photo_vision_cache. Provider probe was widened to also recognize direct keys, day_narrative agent gets the merged evidence bundle including production/constraints/day_impacts/tomorrow_plan/pm_needs, frontend timeout raised to 60s. All verified in this iteration.
